name: Shadow Crafting
body:
You are able to create magical areas of darkness.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, 3rd-level Shadowdancer

Benefit: Once per day per level of shadowdancer you possess, you are able to imitate the effects of a darkness spell. Your caster level for this effect is equal to your shadowdancer level.
